title: Förändringsledare Säkerhetskultur
description: E.ON i Sverige är en del av den internationella energikoncernen E.ON SE med huvudkontor i Essen, Tyskland. Inom koncernen arbetar runt 70 000 personer i 17 länder. Runt om i Sverige arbetar runt 2100 engagerade medarbetare. Vårt nordiska huvudkontor finns i Malmö. I Sverige levererar vi el, värme och smarta energilösningar till drygt en miljon hushåll och företag. E.ON:s roll är att ta ansvar för och driva utvecklingen framåt, för att fler ska kunna ställa om. Med våra investeringar och våra kunders vilja att bidra arbetar vi för att fortsätta elektrifiera samhället och möta framtidens energibehov.Om ossVill du vara med och skapa en kultur där fysisk säkerhet och en trygg arbetsmiljö är en självklar del av hur vi tänker, agerar och fattar beslut? Vår ambition är tydlig: alla som arbetar för E.ON ska komma hem tryggt och må bra varje dag, vår Vision 0.Vi har under flera år arbetat systematiskt med vår säkerhetskultur och använder Bradley-kurvan som stöd för att förstå vår utveckling. Nu vill vi ta nästa steg mot en mer självständig och proaktiv säkerhetskultur, där människor känner ett aktivt ägarskap för sin egen och andras fysiska säkerhet.Vi vill tillsammans med verksamheten förstå vilka förflyttningar som faktiskt gör skillnad och omsätta dem i konkreta beteenden i vardagen. Din rollSom förändringsledare får du en central roll i vår fortsatta kulturförflyttning. Du rör dig mellan våra strategiska ambitioner och vardagen i verksamheten och skapar engagemang genom att lyssna, involvera och utmana. Målet är att det fysiska säkerhetsarbetet i allt högre grad ska ägas och drivas av verksamheten själv.I rollen kommer du bland annat att:• Driva initiativ som stärker ägarskap och personligt ansvar för fysisk säkerhet hos medarbetare, ledare och entreprenörer• Arbeta nära verksamheten för att tillsammans identifiera vilka förändringar som kan skapa verklig effekt• Omsätta kunskap om säkerhetskultur, beteenden och ledarskap till enkla och användbara arbetssätt• Skapa engagemang och delaktighet och bidra till samtal om varför vi arbetar som vi gör• Tillsammans med verksamheten testa, utvärdera och skala upp initiativ och arbetssätt• Stärka lärandet från både det som går bra och det som går fel och omsätta lärdomar i förändrade beteenden• Följa och synliggöra kulturförflyttningen genom data, dialog, observationer och återkoppling• Skapa strukturer för erfarenhetsutbyte och lärande mellan verksamhet, projekt och entreprenörer. En viktig del av uppdraget är att ibland arbeta utan ett färdigt facit. Tillsammans med verksamheten utforskar du vad som behöver förändras, provar lösningar, lär och justerar längs vägen. Dina erfarenheterVi söker dig som är nyfiken på människor och på vad som faktiskt får oss att förändra våra beteenden. Du är trygg i att driva förändring i en komplex organisation och har förmågan att skapa förtroendefulla relationer med såväl ledning som personer nära den operativa verksamheten. Du kan lyssna och involvera samtidigt som du vågar utmana invanda perspektiv när det behövs.Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet inom ett eller flera områden som förändringsledning och kulturförflyttning, beteendebaserat förändrings- eller säkerhetsarbete, arbetsmiljö och säkerhetskultur, projekt- eller verksamhetsutveckling eller ledarutveckling. Erfarenhet av att arbeta tillsammans med entreprenörer och leverantörer är också värdefull.Har du erfarenhet från elsäkerhetsarbete ser vi det som värdefullt, men det är inte avgörande. För oss är din förmåga att skapa engagemang, bygga relationer och bidra till att andra känner ägarskap minst lika viktig.Som person uppskattar du att skapa struktur och framdrift tillsammans med andra. Du knyter kontakter och bygger nätverk över olika delar av organisationen och har förmågan att leda och skapa förutsättningar för andra att bidra och nå gemensamma mål. Hur är det hos oss?Här får du möjlighet att arbeta med arbetsmiljö och säkerhetskultur nära både människor och verksamhet. Du får inte bara följa vår kulturförflyttning utan vara med och forma den tillsammans med dem som möter arbetsmiljöfrågorna i sin vardag.Vi vill skapa en organisation där arbetsmiljö och fysisk säkerhet inte enbart är en fråga om regler, processer och uppföljning, utan något vi tar gemensamt ansvar för genom våra beteenden, vårt ledarskap och våra handlingar. Det innebär en miljö där vi är nyfikna på vad som fungerar, lär av våra erfarenheter och utvecklar våra arbetssätt tillsammans. Varmt välkommen att söka och var med oss på vägen mot ett mer hållbart samhälle! Sista ansökningsdag är 22 november. På E.ON arbetar vi aktivt med inkludering - det är avgörande för att driva energiomställningen framåt. Vi vill att just du ska känna dig välkommen! Vi strävar efter att skapa en trygg arbetsmiljö med meningsfulla arbetsuppgifter och goda möjligheter till utveckling. Vi fortsätter hela tiden att utmana oss själva för att skapa en välkomnande arbetsplats, där vi hoppas att du kommer att trivas. Vi arbetar för ett mer hållbart energisamhälle, men det är minst lika viktigt att våra medarbetare har förutsättningar att värna om sin egen hållbarhet. Vi erbjuder därför bra förmåner för att du ska må bra och ha god balans mellan arbete och fritid. Några av dessa är t.ex. arbetstidsförkortning som är högre än branschens standard, hälsoförsäkring, fri sjukvård och mer därtill! För frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef:Jeanette Bosund, jeanette.bosund@eon.se För fackliga frågor, vänligen kontakta:Unionen, Unionen.EED@eon.se Akademikerna, Akademikerna@eon.se Mattias Andolfsson, Ledarna, mattias.andolfsson@eon.seMats Lundberg, SEKO, +46 730 499778

title: Outlet Manager
description: Role SummaryThe Outlet Manager runs day-to-day operations at Uma's Momo, a fast-casual restaurant and take-away in Gothenburg, as we prepare to open our next location. The role goes beyond running a single outlet: the successful candidate will build structured, practical ways of working that support both our current restaurant and our next location, focused on guest issue resolution, demand-based staffing, delivery-order handling, learning from incidents, quality checks and coaching, guest feedback, and training new staff. We are looking for a calm, methodical problem-solver with a strong focus on the guest experience and the ability to turn feedback and data into improvements on the floor. We have seen strong traction since opening, and being able to start immediately is a big plus.Key Responsibilities●     Develop and own a guest issue-resolution procedure that classifies complaints and incidents by severity (for example, an allergen reaction is critical and a wrong order is minor), sets out what staff can resolve on the spot (such as a free remake or refund) and what is escalated to the manager, and ensures every case is logged and reviewed●     Build and manage staff rotas around expected demand, including lunch and dinner peaks, keeping labour cost on target, adjusting staffing in real time, and sharing staff between locations while the next location gets established●     Set clear, rule-based handling for delivery and online orders, including missing items, late deliveries and refund claims, so that cases are resolved quickly and consistently●     Go beyond completing HACCP logs: when a food-safety check fails (for example, a temperature reading), investigate the root cause and put corrective and preventive actions in place so it does not recur●     Carry out regular service and food-quality spot checks using simple scorecards, and use the results to coach staff●     Monitor Google and delivery-app reviews, reply to guests, and turn patterns into fixes●     Train new staff to our service and food-safety standards ahead of the next opening●     Interpret sales, food, labour and waste figures in our dashboards, and act on them●     Lead daily outlet operations, including opening and closing, front-of-house service, kitchen coordination, HACCP and hygiene standards, and supplier ordering and stock control Required Skills and Profile●     Master’s degree or equivalent in Business, Management, Hospitality or similar●     Experience in operations, customer service or hospitality, including handling escalated customer complaints (international experience acceptable)●     Fluent in English. Fluency in Nepali strongly preferred.●     Experience in staff scheduling or demand-based workforce planning●     Experience writing customer-issue procedures and investigating recurring problems●     Experience training and coaching teams, including running quality checks●     Ability to read and interpret dashboards and reports on sales, costs and performance●     Root cause analysis or Six Sigma experience is an advantage●     Understanding of food‑safety principles and willingness to undertake required certifications Additional InformationThe role combines managerial and hands-on operational work. Hours will be irregular, including evenings and weekends. A salary review will be conducted after 6 months post-probation, or upon meeting agreed performance milestones.The employer complies fully with Swedish employment requirements, and provides the standard SAF-LO package including TFA (Work Injury Insurance), TGL (Group Life Insurance); AGS (Group Sickness Insurance); Avtalspension SAF-LO (Occupational Pension, 4.5% of salary); Premium-waiver insurance and related SAF-LO components The employer is committed to equality of opportunity and to creating a workplace that is free from discrimination on grounds of gender, gender identity or expression, ethnicity, religion or other belief, disability, sexual orientation or age To apply, please submit your CV and cover letter through the application form at umasmomo.com/join (Work with us), stating that you are applying for the Outlet Manager role, by 31st November 2026 DO NOT email or call the restaurant phone number, this will result in automatic disqualification.

title: PhD student in animal welfare and cognition - time perception in animals
description: Department of Applied Animal Science and WelfareThird-cycle subject areaAnimal ScienceDescription of the doctoral projectThis PhD project aims to establish subjective time perception as a new animal-centred dimension of animal welfare. It combines animal welfare science, ethology, comparative cognition, affective neuroscience and human time-perception research. The project will examine how affective state, predictability and agency influence animals’ temporal experience, using dogs as the principal model species.About the positionThe PhD student will:    conduct a structured interdisciplinary review of time perception and its relevance to animal welfare    adapt, pilot and validate an interval-timing task for dogs    design and conduct experiments examining timing behaviour under neutral, positive and mildly negative affective conditions    train dogs using positive reinforcement and collect behavioural and physiological data    analyse video recordings, operant responses, heart rate, heart-rate variability and salivary cortisol    contribute to the development of a conceptual framework for studying time perception across companion, farm, laboratory and zoo animals    publish the findings in international scientific journals and present them at national and international conferencesYou will join an interdisciplinary and international research environment with expertise in animal welfare, animal cognition, and affective states. The position provides opportunities to develop skills in animal experimentation, cognitive testing, behavioural analysis, physiological measurements, statistics and scientific communication.RequirementsTo meet the general entry requirements you must have been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification, satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39).The specific entry requirements for the subject animal science are knowledge corresponding to at least 120 higher education credits in biology subjects, of which a total of at least 30 credits must be in animal science. This must include at least 30 credits at advanced level and the student must have demonstrated the ability to work independently in a degree project. Applicants with a different, comparable educational background may be eligible; this will be decided by the faculty board on a case-by case basis.You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6.Your profileAt the time of employment, you must have completed a Master’s degree, or equivalent, in animal science, biology, ethology, veterinary science, psychology, cognitive science, neuroscience or another relevant subject.You should have:    a strong interest in animal behaviour, animal welfare and cognition    experience or training in experimental research and quantitative data analysis    experience in ethogram development, behavioural observations and/or video coding    the ability to plan, document and complete research tasks independently    excellent written and spoken EnglishExperience considered a merit:    handling or training dogs or other animals using positive reinforcement    cognitive or operant testing    collection or analysis of heart-rate variability, cortisol or other physiological data    statistical analysis in R or similar softwareAs a person, you should be curious, patient, analytical and attentive to detail. You should be comfortable working both independently and collaboratively and have a responsible and ethically sensitive approach to research involving animals. Good organisational and communication skills are important because the project involves collaboration across scientific disciplines and with international research partners.About us More information about the department: https://www.slu.se/en/departments/department-of-applied-animal-science-and-welfareRead more about staff benefits and life as an SLU employee on https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/ Read more about third-cycle courses and study programmes on http://www.slu.se/utbildning/program-kurser/forskarutbildning/Form of employment / Funding Employment as a doctoral student (4-year programme)Doctoral student’s salaries are set following the local collective agreement. Salary progression is fixed.Location: UppsalaScope: 100%Start date: As soon as possible, or upon agreement. Application and selection: Please submit your application using the link below. The deadline is 7 of December 2026.Read more about the attachments that your application should include at https://www.slu.se/en/study/programmes-courses/doctoral-education/how-can-i-become-a-doctoral-student/application/Selection among eligible applicants is based on the documents attached to the application, and is carried out with regard to the applicant’s ability to complete the programme within the allotted time.Academic union representatives:https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/ The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. With over 330 years of heritage and a passion for pioneering technology, we design and deliver world class products and solutions for forest, park, garden and construction care. Our mission is to provide customers with the right products, at the right time, while maintaining capital efficiency and operational excellence. title: Completions Engineer Co-Ordinator (Field
description: Experienced Completions Engineer Coordinator required to support construction completion, mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning and handover across a multi-disciplinary EPCM project transitioning green energy technology into steel manufacturing.The role provides hands-on field coordination and verification, including Inspection Test Record (ITR) management, punch list close-out, system readiness checks and turnover documentation. Working closely with Construction, Quality, Engineering, Commissioning, Operations, vendors, EPCs and subcontractors, the role ensures equipment and systems are safely installed, tested, documented and ready for controlled handover.Key ResponsibilitiesField Completion & Inspection    Perform field walkdowns and verify mechanical, piping, electrical, instrumentation, controls and utility installations against approved drawings, specifications, vendor requirements and project standards.    Coordinate and witness construction completion and pre-commissioning inspections across assigned systems, subsystems and work fronts.    Verify inspection readiness, including access, permits, isolations, procedures, calibrated test equipment, materials and vendor support.    Identify installation defects, incomplete work, and drawing discrepancies, and coordinate resolution with Engineering, Construction, Quality, and contractors.Mechanical Completion & ITRs    Execute, review and verify ITRs, check sheets and supporting evidence for construction, mechanical completion and pre-commissioning activities.    Ensure ITRs are correctly allocated to equipment tags, systems, disciplines and work packs within the completions management system.    Verify test data, signatures, dates, attachments, red-line mark-ups, punch references and acceptance/witness approvals.    Support preparation and verification of mechanical completion certificates and system readiness packs.Pre-Commissioning, Commissioning & Start-Up    Support cleaning, flushing, pressure/leak testing, drying, reinstatement, loop checks, functional testing, energisation readiness and equipment run testing.    Confirm prerequisites, permits, isolations, test packs, procedures, tools, consumables and vendor support are available before testing.    Record test results, equipment status, deviations and actions, ensuring commissioning records are correctly uploaded and linked.    Support dynamic commissioning and start-up, including troubleshooting, reinstatement, retesting and technical issue close-out.Punch List Management    Raise clear, evidence-based punch items for incomplete, defective or non-compliant work.    Categorise, prioritise and assign punch items to the correct tag, system, drawing, ITR or work pack.    Coordinate punch close-out with EPCs, subcontractors, vendors, and discipline teams, and verify remedial work before closure.    Escalate overdue, high-risk or commissioning-critical items and recommend recovery actions.Systemisation, Turnover & Handover    Apply approved system/subsystem boundaries, turnover priorities and commissioning sequences.    Support development and field validation of system boundary drawings, tag lists, Work Execution Flows (WEFs), turnover packages and completion dossiers.    Participate in mechanical completion, pre-commissioning and Ready for Commissioning walkdowns.    Confirm required certificates, test reports, red-line drawings, vendor documentation, punch status and preservation records are complete before turnover.Completions Systems & Documentation    Maintain accurate completions data covering tag status, ITR progress, punch items, certificates, test records and handover documentation.    Monitor ITR status, inspection backlog, punch trends, documentation gaps and readiness constraints.    Ensure records are accurate, traceable, audit-ready and compliant with project quality and document-control requirements.    Compile completion dossiers, turnover packages and final handover records.Coordination, HSSE & Reporting    Coordinate interfaces between Construction, Quality, Engineering, Planning, Commissioning, Operations, vendors, EPCs and subcontractors.    Participate in daily coordination, look-ahead, progress, readiness and punch review meetings.    Report on inspections, ITR status, punch closure, testing progress, constraints and forecast activities.    Support practical training on ITR execution, punch control, completions systems and handover requirements.    Work in accordance with HSSE requirements, permit-to-work controls, isolation procedures, risk assessments and applicable regulations.    Stop and escalate unsafe work, uncontrolled energisation or non-compliant testing.    Promote safe execution, right-first-time quality, accurate records and controlled handover.Required Qualifications & Experience    Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Controls or related Engineering discipline.    Minimum 10 years’ experience in construction, completions, pre-commissioning, commissioning or start-up within an EPC/EPCM environment, ideally within green energy, steel, process plants, oil & gas, mining, power or heavy industry.    Strong field experience in mechanical completion, inspections, ITR execution, punch management and system handover.    Working knowledge of mechanical, piping, electrical, instrumentation and control commissioning processes.    Ability to interpret P&IDs, single-line diagrams, loop drawings, layouts, equipment data sheets, specifications, ITPs, vendor manuals and commissioning procedures.    Strong knowledge of HSSE, quality requirements, permit-to-work, isolation and testing controls.    Strong organisational, problem-solving, communication and multidisciplinary coordination skills.Desired Skills    Practical knowledge of Completions, Systemisation, Commissioning and Start-Up through to operational handover.    Experience with PCMSPro, PIMS, ICAPS, WinPCS or equivalent completions management systems.    Experience with system boundary drawings, WEFs, test packs, readiness checklists, turnover packages and completion dossiers.    Experience coordinating vendors, subcontractors and client representatives during testing, commissioning and start-up.    Competence with project controls, document management, dashboards and Microsoft Office.    Strong technical writing, reporting, data-quality and document-traceability skills.    Ability to work effectively across disciplines, cultures and contractor organisations.    Willingness to work on site and support shift or extended-hour activities when required.

description: Job ID: 4069Senior/Lead Quantitative Risk Analyst, Wholesale Model Validation - IRB (permanent position)We are looking for a credible and highly experienced Wholesale IRB model risk professional who combines deep technical expertise, regulatory experience and strong leadership skills gained within SSM-supervised banks.About our teamMeet the Wholesale Model Validation team. reviews, on-site inspections and other supervisory engagements relating to Wholesale IRB models.     Coaching and developing colleagues: Provide technical guidance, coaching and constructive challenge validation activities, effectively managing deliverables, dependencies and competing priorities.     Building trusted relationships: Communicate complex validation conclusions clearly and constructively to senior management, model owners, developers and other stakeholders, while safeguarding the independence of the validation function.     Strengthening the function: Shape and title: PhD student in Environmental Science
description: We have the power of over 50,000 students and co-workers. Students who provide hope for the future. Co-workers who contribute to Linköping University meeting challenges of today. Our fundamental values rest on credibility, trust and security. By having the courage to think freely and innovate, our actions together, large and small, contribute to a better world. We look forward to receiving your application!We are now looking for a PhD in Environmental Science with focus on chemical characterization of effluent organic matter.Your work assignmentsYou will be a part of a national transdisciplinary center of excellence called Biogas Solutions Research Center (BSRC). Here, co-production of new and relevant knowledge is generated through collaboration between different scientific disciplines as well as between researchers and practitioners from industry and public organizations. The BSRC includes researchers and support from two universities, Linköping University and Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences, as well as about 50 private and public organizations involving all parts of the biogas system (http://www.biogasresearchcenter.se). It also has support from the Swedish Energy Agency. This position is announced as part of the research area "Substrates,  Processes, and Products" within BSRC.Processing of biomass residues for material and energy recovery generate effluents containing complex organic mixtures. The main purpose of the PhD project is to investigate molecular complexity of effluent organic matter from sources such as agricultural, municipal and industrial activities and to assess their characterization and transformation where these materials are processed, with emphasis on anaerobic bioprocessing technologies. Current understanding of the dynamics of effluent organic matter mainly refers to change of bulk properties. The proposed research aims to advance this science to knowledge of transformation processes at the molecular level using advanced analyses like nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy and high-resolution mass spectrometry (MS). This knowledge will enable defining strategies to promote the utilization of effluent organic matter as potential valuable products.Understanding the molecular complexity of effluent organic matter has a particular relevance due to the significance of these material streams as biofertilizers and sustainable sources of nitrogen, phosphorus, and carbon. The PhD project intends to assess utilization of effluent organic matter as biofertilizers for enhancing the soil health and carbon stock, promoting circular bioeconomy principles for sustainable food production.As a PhD student you will be expected to conduct independent research in line with the research focus. The work assignments particularly relate to the focus area on interplay between physicochemical and microbiological parameters with dynamics of organic matter in anaerobic bioprocesses. Also, it includes the management and feeding of biogas reactors with the focus of production of specific organic molecules of interest. This includes responsibility for research that involves planning, sampling, reactor maintenance, overall laboratory work connected to biogas processes, data processing and writing scientific articles.As a doctoral student, you devote most of your time to doctoral studies and the research project of which you are a part. Your work may also include teaching or other departmental duties, up to a maximum of 20% of full-time.Your qualificationsRelevant subjects for eligibility include, for example, analytical chemistry, environmental chemistry, chemical biology, chemical engineering, or an equivalent field. You have graduated at Master´s level or completed courses with a minimum of 240 credits, at least 60 of which must be on advanced level. Alternatively, you have gained corresponding knowledge in another way. Special qualifications: 90 credits of your total credits should be in a subject of central importance to the research area.Documented practical experience and theoretical knowledge in advanced chemistry, nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy, and the planning and execution of laboratory studies are particularly merited. Documented practical experience and theoretical knowledge in the operation and monitoring of bioreactors are merited.Great importance will be placed on personal qualities and suitability. You are independent, responsible, and meticulous, with the ability to structure and drive your work forward. You have a strong focus on quality, pay close attention to detail, and regard accurate laboratory documentation as an important part of your work. We also expect you to have the willingness and ability to learn new techniques and concepts, particularly in chemistry, and to apply them in an interdisciplinary research environment. title: Senior Non-Motor Pricing Actuary (m/f/d)
description: Shape sustainable pricing across Swiss Property, Household, Liability and SME insurance. You will combine actuarial modelling with underwriting insight and take end\-to\-end responsibility from exposure data and technical pricing to implementation and portfolio monitoring. Your work will help us make transparent, risk\-adequate decisions even where portfolios are heterogeneous and data are limited.Senior Non\-Motor Pricing Actuary (m/f/d)CELEBRATE SUCCESS, TOGETHER.Navigating real life together.**What to expect*** You develop, validate and enhance technical pricing models for selected Swiss Property, Household, Liability and SME portfolios.* You model frequency, attritional severity, large losses and inflation and apply exposure\-based methods that reflect sums insured, location, occupancy, business activity, limits and deductibles.* You combine statistical evidence with underwriting expertise when data are sparse or heterogeneous, while making assumptions and expert adjustments transparent and reviewable.* You translate analyses into practical tariff and underwriting measures, including minimum premiums, loadings, discounts, deductibles, limits and referral rules.* You take end\-to\-end responsibility from exposure\-data preparation and model documentation through implementation and testing. After launch, you measure realised impact against the approved business case, separating rate, exposure, risk\-mix, large\-loss, inflation and implementation effects.* You partner with Underwriting, Product Management, Claims, Reinsurance, Risk Management, Compliance, Data and IT and communicate uncertainty in a decision\-oriented way.* You improve reproducible pricing workflows and portfolio monitoring, responsibly apply AI\-assisted methods to data preparation, modelling, code review, testing and documentation, and support colleagues through technical review and mentoring.**The skills you'll bring*** You hold a degree in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, data science, economics or a comparable quantitative field.* You bring several years of hands\-on Non\-Life pricing experience in Property, Household, Liability, SME, Commercial or another relevant portfolio in Switzerland or a comparable European market.* You understand frequency\-severity and exposure modelling, credibility methods, large\-loss volatility and the challenges of incomplete or heterogeneous insurance data.* You have translated pricing analysis into tariff or underwriting decisions and have contributed to an implemented pricing tool, tariff or portfolio action.* You program confidently in at least one relevant analytical language, preferably Python, R or SAS. You actively explore approved AI\-assisted development tools, including coding copilots and agentic coding environments, and validate their outputs with professional judgement.* You have very good English and German skills. Il gère et coordonne quatre régimes d'assurance : assurance\\-vieillesse et survivants, assurance\\-invalidité, allocations familiales et allocations pour perte de gain. Pour relever les défis actuels, l'OCAS est à la recherche d'un\\-e \*\*Responsable conformité\*\* (100 %) Classe de fonction 23 Au sein du domaine des services partagés et rattaché\\-e au responsable adjoint du domaine, vous avez pour mission de construire et piloter le nouveau secteur conformité de l'OCAS. Vous donnez à l'institution une vue unique de sa maîtrise en matière de gestion des risques, de contrôle interne, de qualité, de sécurité de l'information et de protection des données. Pour ce faire, vous réunissez et développez les dispositifs existants que la loi impose aux organes d'exécution du 1er pilier. Dans un contexte réglementaire exigeant et en évolution, vous priorisez selon les risques que l'institution doit maîtriser. Dans une logique de deuxième ligne de maîtrise, vous élaborez et déployez progressivement le cadre méthodologique, accompagnez la mise en œuvre par les secteurs et les domaines, qui restent responsables de leurs risques, et contrôlez l'efficacité du dispositif. Vous rendez compte de l'état de maîtrise à la direction générale et à la commission risques du conseil d'administration. Vous conduisez une équipe de deux spécialistes en sécurité de l'information et en protection des données. Ce poste s'adresse à une personnalité fédératrice et résolue, dotée d'un bon esprit de synthèse, capable de faire appliquer des exigences de maîtrise sans se substituer aux métiers. \*\*Vos title: Chargé de marketing et de communication
description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Chargé·e de marketing et de communication --- Chargé·e de marketing et de communication =========================================== \*\*CHANGINS\*\* Haute école de viticulture et œnologie (HES\\-SO), est le pôle de référence suisse et international pour la formation et la recherche dans les domaines de la viticulture et de l'œnologie. Depuis plus de 75 ans, nous formons et accompagnons les professionnel·les de la filière, de la terre au verre. Dans le cadre de sa Stratégie 2030, CHANGINS élargit désormais son périmètre aux boissons fermentées, affirmant ainsi une ambition renouvelée pour l'ensemble de ses filières. Pour renforcer son rayonnement et attirer les futur·es étudiant·es de ses différentes filières, CHANGINS recherche un·e : \*\*Chargé·e de marketing et de communication (60 -- 80 %)\*\* Vos missions ------------ Rattaché·e au Directeur, vous contribuez au recrutement des étudiant·es et à la communication institutionnelle de CHANGINS, en soutien aux filières de formation, à l'École du vin et à la Recherche \\\& Innovation. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec le Secrétariat général, qui vous apporte un soutien opérationnel pour le site web, les événements, les bases de contacts et la collecte de contenus. Vous pouvez également vous appuyer sur des prestataires externes, selon les besoins et le budget validé. ### Recrutement des étudiant·es \* Concevoir et réaliser des campagnes digitales ciblées (réseaux sociaux, publicité en ligne, séquences d'e\\-mails) afin de générer et qualifier des contacts, puis les transmettre aux filières et au secrétariat concernés. \* Animer nos stands lors des salons et foires et organiser, avec le Secrétariat général, la Journée des formations et les Portes ouvertes. Une disponibilité occasionnelle le week\\-end est nécessaire pour certains salons et événements. ### Communication institutionnelle et contenus \* Coordonner les contenus du site web, avec le soutien du Secrétariat général pour les mises à jour, et garantir l'application cohérente de l'identité visuelle sur tous les supports. \* Produire des textes, newsletters, communiqués et vidéos courtes qui valorisent nos formations, nos projets et nos diplômé·es. \* Couvrir nos événements institutionnels, dont la cérémonie des diplômes. \* Valoriser les projets de Recherche \\\& Innovation avec les équipes de recherche. ### Relations publiques et médias \* Être le point de contact des journalistes et entretenir les relations avec les médias régionaux, nationaux et spécialisés. \* Veiller à la cohérence et à la conformité des communications institutionnelles et soumettre les sujets sensibles à la Direction, qui décide de leur communication. \* Préparer et coordonner les prises de parole publiques, en collaboration avec la Direction, porte\\-parole de l'institution, et les personnes concernées. ### Budget et suivi des résultats \* Proposer et gérer le budget marketing et communication, dans l'enveloppe validée par la Direction, et piloter les prestataires (graphistes, imprimeurs, agences). \* Suivre les indicateurs de performance, notamment les contacts générés et qualifiés, ainsi que les inscriptions en collaboration avec les filières et le secrétariat des missions, et en rendre compte régulièrement aux filières et à la Direction. Profil souhaité ---------------- ### Formation et expérience \* Bachelor ou Master en marketing, communication ou domaine jugé équivalent, ou brevet fédéral de spécialiste en marketing ou en communication. \* 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en marketing digital, idéalement en recrutement, en formation ou en marketing de services, avec des résultats chiffrés à présenter. \* Maîtrise pratique d'un CRM ou d'un outil d'e\\-mailing automatisé, des réseaux sociaux et de leur publicité, d'un outil de gestion de site web et des outils d'analyse. \* Expérience des relations médias, de la gestion d'un budget et du pilotage de prestataires ; sens du discernement dans la communication institutionnelle. ### Compétences et qualités \* Excellente maîtrise du français, à l'oral comme à l'écrit, et bonnes connaissances de l'allemand. \* La connaissance de l'italien ou de l'anglais constitue un atout. \* Aisance relationnelle avec un public varié, sur les stands et lors d'événements. \* Sens du service, autonomie et capacité à gérer les priorités de plusieurs interlocuteurs internes. \* Compétences en montage vidéo et intérêt pour le monde du vin : un plus. Ce que nous vous offrons ------------------------ \* Un rôle concret et visible : vous contribuez directement au recrutement des futur·es professionnel·les de la vigne, du vin et des boissons fermentées. \* Un lien direct avec la Direction et une grande autonomie dans la réalisation. \* Un taux d'activité de 60 à 80 % et la possibilité de télétravailler selon les besoins. \* Un cadre de travail exceptionnel à Nyon, entre Lac Léman et vignobles. Informations pratiques ---------------------- \*\*Entrée en fonction :\*\* à convenir \*\*Taux d'activité :\*\* 60 à 80 % \*\*Lieu de travail :\*\* Route de Duillier 52, CH -- 1260 Nyon \*\*Délai de postulation :\*\* Merci de postuler uniquement via JobUp. !\[Fondation Changins\]( ) \* Fondation Changins Route de Duillier 52 1260 Nyon \* \[ \](\< \>) jpid8b32011jm jpit1147jm jpiy26jm

description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Key Account Manager Foodservice (a.G., 100%) - IT--- Key Account Manager Foodservice (a.G., 100%) \- IT==================================================**SCOPRI LE NOSTRE OFFERTE DI LAVORO** **85'500 DIPENDENTI \| 94 PAESI \| NO. 1 MONDIALE DEL SETTORE LATTIERO\-CASEARIO**  I nostri marchi di Lactalis Suisse SA \- **BAER, Galbani, Leerdammer, Président e Salakis** \- rappresentano qualità, gusto e affidabilità. Produciamo in Svizzera e facciamo parte del Gruppo Lactalis francese, leader mondiale nel settore dei prodotti lattiero\-caseari e dei formaggi.  Ciò che per noi è importante: il rispetto reciproco, l'apertura verso nuove prospettive e la fiducia nella responsabilità individuale di ciascuno. La nostra collaborazione si orienta a valori chiari: **Ambizione \& Impegno con Semplicità**. Questo approccio caratterizza il nostro modo di pensare, decidere e agire.  Nel Marketing e nelle Vendite lavorano a stretto contatto circa 40 colleghe e colleghi. La comunicazione è diretta e la collaborazione è pragmatica e collegiale. Il tuo team è multiculturale e non vede l'ora di accogliere una nuova persona motivata, con la voglia di contribuire attivamente alla costruzione e allo sviluppo di qualcosa di nuovo.  A seguito del nuovo orientamento strategico della nostra divisione Foodservice, siamo alla ricerca di un ulteriore membro del team con passione per le vendite, il food e lo sviluppo imprenditoriale per la posizione di:  Key Account Manager Foodservice (a.G., 100%)============================================**Luogo di lavoro:** Küssnacht am Rigi  con il 40\-60% di trasferte nella Svizzera tedesca (in particolare Zurigo, Argovia, Lucerna, )### Qui nasce qualcosa di nuovo e tu ne fai parte fin dall'inizioIn questa nuova posizione, lascerai il tuo segno e porterai i nostri marchi sinonimo di piacere e gioia di vivere nei luoghi in cui le persone si ritrovano a tavola: hotel, ristoranti, ospedali e strutture assistenziali.  La tua capacità di comprendere le esigenze dei clienti, il tuo network già consolidato nel Foodservice svizzero, dalla ristorazione organizzata e dall'hotellerie fino agli ospedali e alle strutture assistenziali, insieme alla tua visione strategica delle opportunità di mercato, ti permetteranno di generare una crescita profittevole. Svilupperai nuove partnership, le consoliderai nel tempo e contribuirai a definire il posizionamento e l'utilizzo dei nostri prodotti sul mercato.### Cosa ti aspetta* Il miglior mix tra il lavoro in un'azienda svizzera ricca di tradizione e un contesto internazionale all'interno di un'impresa familiare con marchi di elevata notorietà.* Creerai le basi affinché possiamo acquisire nuovi clienti, rafforzare le relazioni esistenti, mantenere visibili i nostri marchi e sviluppare ulteriormente il nostro assortimento in modo mirato. La tua quotidianità sarà varia, stimolante e molto vicina ai clienti.* Beneficerai di condizioni di impiego attrattive e di prestazioni accessorie superiori alla media. Tra queste figurano da un minimo di 25 a un massimo di 35 giorni di vacanza e un'auto aziendale che potrai utilizzare anche privatamente. title: Membership Growth and Club Experience Specialist - Africa & The Middle East
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Membership Growth and Club Experience Specialist - Africa &amp; The Middle East (100%)--- Membership Growth and Club Experience Specialist \- Africa \& The Middle East (100%)====================================================================================People of Action----------------Rotary is a global network of 1\.4 million neighbors, friends, leaders, and problem\-solvers who see a world where people unite and take action to create lasting change – across the globe, in our communities, and in ourselves. For more than 120 years, Rotary's people of action have used their passion, energy, and intelligence to take action on sustainable projects.Help Rotary grow its impact across Africa and the Middle East-------------------------------------------------------------Do you enjoy building relationships, coordinating processes, and supporting volunteers who create positive change in their communities? Join Rotary International and play a key role in strengthening clubs, supporting membership growth, and helping volunteer leaders across Africa and the Middle East create exceptional experiences for current and future members.Working with an international network of dedicated volunteers, you will combine customer service, stakeholder engagement, and operational excellence to support Rotary's mission of bringing people together to create lasting change.As per immediate availability or upon agreement, our team in Zurich has an opening for an**Membership Growth and Club Experience Specialist \- (100%)**--------------------------------------------------------------### Africa \& The Middle EastAs a member of the Membership Growth \& Club Experience team, you will support Rotary and Rotaract clubs across Africa and the Middle East by helping strengthen the member experience, supporting membership growth and retention, and facilitating new club development.You will serve as a key point of contact for district and club leaders, providing guidance, operational support, and practical solutions that help volunteers attract, engage, and retain members while ensuring the smooth administration of club\-related processes. Working closely with Rotary International directors and regional volunteer leaders, you will contribute to membership initiatives that support sustainable growth and strong, vibrant clubs throughout the region.This position offers an excellent opportunity to build a career within a global membership organization while working in a highly international and purpose\-driven environment.Your Contributions to the Team------------------------------* Serve as a primary contact for district leaders, club presidents, membership chairs, and volunteers throughout Africa and the Middle East, supporting membership growth, engagement, retention, and new club development.* Coordinate and facilitate approximately 20 new club applications per month (with higher volumes during peak periods), while also administering club mergers, name changes, and club terminations, ensuring an efficient and positive experience for clubs and districts.* Support member acquisition efforts through Rotary's prospective member management platform (Salesforce) and through initiatives designed to engage potential new members.* Build strong relationships with volunteer leaders and develop into a trusted advisor on club governance, leadership practices, and positive club culture.* Partner with zone, district, and club leaders to identify opportunities and share effective approaches that strengthen clubs and improve the member experience.* As your expertise grows, provide training, guidance, and resources that help clubs increase engagement, improve retention, foster diversity, and establish new clubs.* Collaborate with colleagues and senior volunteer leaders to advance membership strategies across the region.* Travel within the assigned territory approximately 2\-3 times per year.What you bring--------------* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.* 3\-5 years of experience in customer service, stakeholder engagement, administration, membership support, volunteer management, or a related field would be preferable.* Proficiency in English and French (written and spoken).* Strong organizational and administrative skills with exceptional attention to detail.* The ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and processes while maintaining a high level of quality and responsiveness.* Confidence interacting with senior business leaders, volunteers, and stakeholders from diverse cultural backgrounds.* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presentations, facilitation, and professional correspondence.* Experience using CRM systems, ideally Salesforce, is an advantage.* Interest in and appreciation for the cultures and contexts of Africa and the Middle East.* A collaborative mindset combined with the ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities.Are you our new team member?----------------------------As our ideal candidate, you can relate to the following Self\-Leading Attributes:* **Engagement** – You foster relationships by hearing, recognizing, and valuing others* **Communication** – You are open to receiving ideas from diverse viewpoints and able to communicate messages so that they are universally understood* **Collaboration** – You build partnerships and work jointly with others to meet shared objectives* **Presence** – You are able to demonstrate composure and confidence and display a professional presence* **Productivity** – You strive to produce consistently excellent results that will help Rotary achieve its goals* **Adaptability** – You respondto changes with a positiveattitude and recognize when to adjustbased on the situation* **Innovation** – You move Rotary beyond traditional ways of thinkingWe offer--------* An international working environment with 44 colleagues representing more than 20 nationalities.* The opportunity to contribute to the mission of one of the world's leading service organizations.* An attractive health insurance program.* A 40\-hour work week.* Flexible working hours.* Option for two home\-office days per week.* Five weeks of vacation.* A collaborative and supportive workplace in Zurich.Ready to join us?-----------------Submit your application in English **by 14 December 2026**, including:* Your curriculum vitae (CV)* A motivation letter* Reference letters.Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and selected candidates may be contacted before the application deadline.Kindly note-----------Rotary is unable to provide visa sponsorship, work permit sponsorship, or relocation assistance for this position. Applicants must already have the legal right to live and work in Switzerland.About Rotary------------At Rotary International, we foster a welcoming environment where all employees are valued and empowered. We are dedicated to creating meaningful opportunities and supporting the growth and well\-being of our team. Join us in building a world where everyone can unite, take action, and create lasting change.The Europe/Africa Office, based in Zurich, is part of the Rotary International Secretariat, headquartered in Evanston, Illinois, USA. Our team of 40 colleagues supports Rotarians throughout Europe, Africa, and the Middle East by providing high\-quality service and helping advance Rotary's mission and strategic priorities.![Rotary International]()* Rotary International  Witikonerstrasse 15  8032 Zürich*jid842e105jm jit1147jm jiy26jm

title: PhD position on Youth Mental Health and Discrimination 100 %
description: Interested in the experiences of discrimination and positive social reactions towards young people with mental health problems? Join our SNSF\\-funded project as a PhD student to find out more! PhD position on Youth Mental Health and Discrimination 100 % \*\*What you will be responsible for\*\* The research project "\[Beyond Stigma: Discrimination and Positive Treatment Toward Young People with Mental Health Problems in a Changing Social Context\](\< \>)" examines the positive and negative reactions experienced by young people with mental health problems in their social environments. The project uses a participatory approach to develop and validate a new questionnaire in close collaboration with young people and professionals. This will be followed by a representative survey assessing the prevalence of different experiences and their associated factors. Led by the Zurich University of Applied Sciences (ZHAW), the project is conducted in collaboration with the Universities of Lausanne, Basel and Fribourg and supported by an international advisory board of renowned researchers. It is funded by the Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF) and the Palatin Foundation. Your tasks: \* Project coordination: Support project management and coordinate activities with project and cooperation partners across German\\- and French\\-speaking Switzerland. \* Evidence synthesis: Conduct literature reviews and systematic evidence syntheses. \* Questionnaire development: Plan, coordinate and implement the participatory development and validation of a questionnaire in collaboration with young people, professionals and project partners. \* Survey implementation: Plan, coordinate and conduct a representative survey. \* Data analysis: Analyse and interpret qualitative and quantitative data. \* Research dissemination and academic development: Prepare scientific publications, present research findings at national and international conferences, contribute to teaching activities, and complete a PhD within a doctoral programme. \*\*What makes you a great fit\*\* \* Successfully completed Master's degree (MSc/MA) in psychology, sociology, public health or a related health or social science discipline \* Strong interest in the project's research topic and motivation to pursue a PhD \* Sound knowledge of qualitative and/or quantitative research \* Experience in data analysis and relevant software, such as R, SPSS, Stata, MAXQDA, and online survey tools \* Ability to work independently and manage tasks in a well\\-organised and reliable manner \* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to engage respectfully and sensitively with young people who have experienced mental health problems \* Good written and spoken German and English skills, as well as an understanding of Swiss German; a good command in French is an asset \*\*About your workplace\*\* The ZHAW Zurich University of Applied Sciences is the largest university of applied sciences in German\\-speaking Switzerland, with around 15,000 students, more than 11,000 continuing education participants and over 3,700 employees. We are committed to building diverse teams in order to promote equality and inclusion. We offer a flexible working environment that can be adapted to your individual circumstances. \*\*School of Health Sciences\*\* The ZHAW School of Health Sciences is Switzerland's largest and most renowned center for education and research in occupational therapy, midwifery and reproductive health, nursing, physical therapy, and public health. We foster a corporate culture that encourages employees to take on responsibility and explore new approaches within the organization, and we have been certified as a Friendly Workspace since 2014\\. \*\*The Public Health research unit (FPH)\*\* The Public Health research unit (FPH) constitutes a multidisciplinary unit including researchers in public health, medicine, sociology, psychology or economics, pursuing applied research from a life course perspective. We offer the opportunity to work on a participatory research project in the highly relevant field of youth mental health. The PhD candidate will be based at the ZHAW Institute of Public Health in Winterthur and will work closely with researchers and project partners from the Universities of Lausanne, Basel and Fribourg, as well as with a national and international advisory board. The candidate will benefit from a stimulating interdisciplinary research environment and collaboration across several academic institutions. Enrolment can take place at the UZH, particularly in the joint ZHAW\\-UZH\\-PhD program "Care \\\& Rehabilitation Sciences". \*\*Any questions? You'll find the answers here!\*\* \*\*Do you have any questions about the applicatio j4id10493270jm j4it1147jm j4iy26jm\*\*

Ob du gerade noch studierst oder schon viele Fälle gelöst hast, ist für uns zweitrangig. Bringst du bereits M\-Files\-Erfahrung mit, bist du für uns ein echter Glückstreffer. Und wenn du noch am Anfang stehst: Auch Sherlock ist nicht als Meisterdetektiv auf die Welt gekommen — wir bilden dich gerne gut aus. Mit deinem technischen Know\-how bringst du uns — ein junges, wachsendes Unternehmen mit dem Ziel die Treuhandbranche zu digitalisieren — über beide Bäckchen zum Lächeln. ### **Dein Ermittlerprofil. Hand aufs — klingt das nach dir?*** Informatik ist dein Fachgebiet? Weltklasse. Du hast dir dein technisches Know\-how anders angeeignet? Auch top. Hauptsache, du weisst, wie man ein System aufsetzt und konfiguriert.* Du siehst in der Digitalisierung die Chance, Prozesse nachhaltig zu optimieren — quasi der rote Faden am Tatort.* IT ist sozusagen dein zweiter Vorname? Datenbankabfragen und Netzwerke brauchst du nicht erst im Archiv nachzuschlagen.* DMS\- oder ECM\-Konfigurationen? Elementar, mein lieber — kann ich schon oder will ich unbedingt lernen.* Dein Deutsch ist so sattelfest, dass selbst der Duden kurz nickt.* Start\-up Vibe, Hands\-On Mentalität und Flexibilität klingen für dich spannend — du brauchst keine Anleitung von Scotland Yard.Ein Hinweis, der uns am Herzen liegt — denn auch Sherlock hat nicht jeden angenommen: Erfahrungsgemäss fühlen sich Personen aus den Bereichen Product Owner, Scrum Master, Business Analyst oder Requirements Engineering in dieser nicht ganz zuhause. Wir sagen das lieber ehrlich vorweg, als dass du es selbst herausfinden musst. ### **Deine nächsten Fälle*** Du unterstützt Unternehmen bei der Findung der massgeschneiderten Lösungen im ECM M\-Files.* Du analysierst gemeinsam mit deinen Kunden ihre Prozesse, erkennst ihre Bedürfnisse und erarbeitest konkrete technische Lösungen — kein gleicht dem anderen.* Du führst technische Konfigurationen im System gerne selber aus und traust dich, etwas auszuprobieren. würde sagen: “Regeln sind nur Empfehlungen.”* ECM Projekte begleitest du in engem Kontakt mit Kunden — vom ersten Verdacht bis zur gelösten Akte. ### **Beweislage: Das spricht für uns*** Ein junges Team (ja okey, mehr oder weniger jung ????) in einer wachsenden Firma* Viel Flexibilität und die Möglichkeit dich wirklich einzubringen* Leidenschaft für das, was wir tun* Den Mut, Dinge auszuprobieren* Eine gute Ausbildung, wenn du noch am Anfang stehst — und viel Raum für deine Erfahrung, wenn du schon Senior bist* KI, die wir gefragt haben, wie gut wir KI verstehen – und die geantwortet hat: “Endlich Leute, die mich wirklich verstehen.”* Kaffee oder Red Bull auf dem Tisch (ausser bei unserem Chef, der trinkt nämlich keinen Kaffee – ja, es ist auch uns ein Rätsel…) ![Luota AG]()* Luota AG  Stettbachstrasse 7  8600 Dübendorf*jidfabd174jm jit1147jm jiy26jm

L’ingéniosité, l’innovation et la qualité de nos produits et de nos services nous ont hissés en tête des marchés mondiaux. Actuellement, pour notre siège situé **à Bienne**, nous recherchons pour notre département « **Vente** » un\-e :TECHNICAL \& ADMINISTRATIVE COORDINATOR (H/F)============================================= **Mission :*** Au sein du département Global Customer Care, vous développez et optimisez les activités, outils et processus du service après\-vente. Vous assurez le support technique, la formation et le suivi de notre réseau international de service, tout en contribuant à l’amélioration continue de nos produits et prestations.    **Responsabilités et les centres de service  * Analyser les retours de produits et les réclamations techniques, en identifier les causes et proposer des solutions avec les départements concernés  * Participer aux réparations réalisées à l’atelier SAV (diagnostic, réparation et contrôles finaux)  * Répondre aux questions techniques et conseiller les clients internes et externes  * Créer et maintenir la documentation technique SAV (instructions de réparation et de contrôle, site aftersales, catalogue d’outillage)  * Faire remonter les informations utiles à l’amélioration des produits et anticiper les besoins SAV lors des lancements de nouveaux produits    **Compétences :*** Formation technique en mécanique et/ou électronique  * Formation ou expérience avérée dans le domaine commercial  * Expérience en gestion de projets, idéalement dans un contexte international  * Expérience dans le support client  * Aisance pédagogique pour l’animation de formations techniques  * Maîtrise des outils informatiques usuels (Microsoft Office 365\) et expérience d’un ERP  * çais et anglais courants, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, toute autre langue est un plus  * Disponibilité pour des déplacements à l’étranger (env. 20 %)  * Orientation clients et résultats, sens de l’écoute et de la négociation, diplomatie  * Esprit d’initiative, sens de l’organisation, esprit de synthèse et bonne gestion du title: Infirmier·ère expert·e en soins intensifs
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Infirmier·ère expert·e en soins intensifs---Infirmier·ère expert·e en soins intensifs============================================La Clinique Source est un établissement de soins aigus pluridisciplinaires unique en son genre. Elle appartient à la Fondation La Source, une institution indépendante et privée à but non lucratif qui chapeaute également l'Institut et Haute École de la Santé La Source. L'indépendance que lui confère ce statut lui permet d'investir continuellement sur les plans humains et technologiques afin de garantir à ses patient·es la meilleure prise en charge possible.   **Nous recherchons un·e  Infirmier·ère expert·e en soins intensifs EPD ES à 80%**   **Informations clés sur le poste :** **Référence :** CLS/RH/2026\.783 / **Type de contrat :** Contrat à Durée Indéterminée à 80% / **Horaires :** en 12 heures \+ ponctuellement horaires 7h\-16h et 11h\-20h / **Date d'entrée :** dès que nous trouvons la bonne personne / **Localisation :** au cœur de Lausanne (M2 arrêt « Riponne » ou Bus 2, 3 ou 21 arrêt « Beaulieu\- »)   **Pourquoi avons\-nous besoin de vous ?** Un membre de notre équipe poursuit aujourd'hui un nouveau projet de formation professionnel. Pour assurer la continuité d'une prise en charge d'excellence en soins intensifs, nous souhaitons accueillir un·e infirmier·ère certifié·e expert·e en soins intensifs EPD ES.    **Que serez\-vous amené·e à faire ?** * Prendre en charge des patient·es présentant des situations aiguës complexes et assurer une surveillance clinique continue  * Réaliser les soins infirmiers et les actes médicaux délégués avec rigueur, en garantissant leur qualité, leur sécurité et leur traçabilité  * Surveiller attentivement l'évolution de l'état de santé des patient·es afin de prévenir et anticiper toutes complications et d'adapter la prise en charge  * Collaborer et coordonner les soins avec l'ensemble des professionnel·les impliqué·es dans la prise en charge  * Communiquer avec les patient·es et leurs proches, en leur apportant écoute, information et soutien tout au long de leur prise en charge  * Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de la qualité et de l'efficience des soins, en s'appuyant sur les données scientifiques et le développement des compétences      **Avec qui allez\-vous travailler ?***      L'équipe des soins intensifs, composée d'une vingtaine de soignant·es, cultive un environnement de travail technique mais serein. Sa dynamique positive repose sur le partage, la bonne humeur et la confiance mutuelle. Animée par un sens des responsabilités, elle aspire à progresser dans un milieu en constante évolution. La qualité du travail résulte d'une collaboration harmonieuse et d'une entraide quotidienne.  *      , Responsable des soins intensifs et de la cardiologie, est au bénéfice d'une expérience pratique de plus de 25 ans dans le milieu de la médecine intensive. Il est défini comme une personne pragmatique dotée d'un brin d'idéalisme, prêtant une attention particulière à la collaboration, à la communication et à la confiance. Il est en constante recherche de nouvelles solutions de développement et de progression.     **Qu'attendons\-nous de vous ?** Les indispensables :* Etre au bénéfice d'un diplôme d'infirmier\-ère HES ou reconnu par la Croix\- Suisse  * Etre titulaire d'un diplôme d'expert·e en soins intensifs EPD ES reconnu par la Société Suisse de Médecine Intensive (SGI\-SSMI)  * Avoir une expérience d'au moins trois ans en soins intensifs ou réanimation  * Etre capable de gérer son stress face aux situations d'urgence  * Posséder une aisance dans les transmissions et une excellente capacité de communication avec une expression claire et adaptée aux situations  Vos atouts :* Expérience et polyvalence dans différentes disciplines médicales et chirurgicales  * Sens des responsabilités et faire preuve de dynamisme, rigueur, anticipation, précision, autonomie et loyauté  * Compétences scientifiques, techniques et humaines permettant de travailler dans une équipe pluridisciplinaire      **Pourquoi choisir la Clinique Source ?** * Rejoindre la plus grande Clinique privée du canton de Vaud et évoluer dans un environnement dynamique, reconnu pour son expertise et son savoir\-faire  * Une unité de soins intensifs de 6 lits certifiée par la SSMI  * Profiter d'un cadre de travail à taille humaine, tout en bénéficiant de la richesse et de la diversité des activités d'une institution de santé tournée vers l'avenir  * Bénéficier de conditions d'engagement attractives et de prestations sociales avantageuses (accueil et intégration, participation LaMal, LPP avantageuse, rabais, etc.)  * Concilier vie professionnelle et vie privée, grâce à des possibilités de travail à temps partiel, jusqu'à plus de 7 semaines de vacances, des congés non payés, des jours fériés compensés et la valorisation du temps de change  * Partager des valeurs qui nous ressemblent : une clinique Unique, Respectueuse, Innovatrice et Responsable      **Quelles sont les prochaines étapes ?*** Vous avez encore des questions sur le poste ? N'hésitez pas à contacter Monsieur   , ICUS expert en soins intensifs et responsable de l'unité de cardiologie au .  * Vous vous reconnaissez dans cette offre ?  **Sadowski**, Spécialiste RH Recrutement, se réjouit de recevoir votre candidature complète (lettre de motivation, CV, certificats et diplômes) directement en ligne sur  * Le poste ne vous correspond pas mais vous êtes intéressé·e par une autre opportunité à la Clinique ? Vous pouvez vous inscrire sur    pour recevoir nos prochaines offres par email.     **Information importante !**Pour des raisons de protection des données, **les candidatures sont exclusivement traitées via notre plateforme en ligne**. Les dossiers transmis par e\-mail ou par courrier ne pourront pas être pris en considération. Vous rencontrez une difficulté technique ? Appelez\-nous au : notre équipe se fera un plaisir de vous accompagner. ![Clinique Source]()* Avenue Vinet 30 1004 Lausanne** ![Clinique Source]()* Avenue Vinet 30 1004 Lausanne**jid4267713jm jit1147jm jiy26jm

Erfahrung mit USV\-Anlagen (unterbrechungsfreie Stromversorgung) ist von Vorteil* Fundierte Kenntnisse in elektromechanischen Systemen, Diagnosetools und Serviceprozessen im industriellen Umfeld* Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung, Flexibilität bei wechselnden Anforderungen sowie eine lösungsorientierte und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise* Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse und grundlegende Englischkenntnisse für die professionelle Kommunikation mit Kunden* Reisebereitschaft, Bereitschaft zur Teilnahme am Pikettdienst sowie zu gelegentlichen Wochenendeinsätzen; title: Responsable d’Atelier – Frigoriste H/F
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Responsable d’Atelier – Frigoriste H/F---Responsable d’Atelier – Frigoriste H/F==========================================Avec 180 pôles services en Europe, un parc de 60’000 véhicules et l’expérience de nos 2’800 collaborateurs, le **Groupe** Fraikin, leader européen de la location multi\-services de véhicules utilitaires et industriels, accompagne chaque jour ses clients grâce à un service clés en main et une expertise reconnue depuis plus de 80 ans. Pour renforcer notre équipe en Suisse romande, nous recherchons un(e) : Responsable d’Atelier – Frigoriste H/F==========================================Vous êtes frigoriste de métier, avec une solide expérience en mécanique, à l’aise avec le diagnostic et souhaitez évoluer vers un poste offrant davantage d’autonomie et de responsabilités ?Nous recherchons un profil capable de combiner expertise technique, polyvalence et organisation de l’atelier. **Votre rôle :**Au sein de l’atelier, vous intervenez directement sur les véhicules tout en assurant la coordination et le suivi des différentes interventions.À ce titre, vous serez notamment amené(e) à :* Réaliser les diagnostics mécaniques, frigorifiques, électriques et électroniques à l’aide des outils de diagnostic.  * Effectuer les travaux d’entretien, de maintenance et de réparation sur les véhicules.  * Apporter votre expertise de frigoriste pour le diagnostic, l’entretien et la réparation des équipements frigorifiques.  * Identifier les pannes et déterminer les travaux et pièces nécessaires à la remise en état des véhicules.  * Rechercher les références de pièces, établir les besoins et passer les commandes auprès des fournisseurs.  * Suivre les disponibilités, les délais et les livraisons afin de limiter au maximum l’immobilisation des véhicules.  * Répartir et prioriser les travaux en fonction du degré d’urgence, des besoins d’exploitation et de la disponibilité des pièces.  * Assurer le suivi de chaque intervention jusqu’à la remise à disposition du véhicule.  * Contrôler la qualité des travaux réalisés et veiller au respect des procédures et des règles de sécurité.  * Assurer le suivi administratif et technique de l’activité à l’aide des outils informatiques et logiciels de gestion d’atelier.  * Participer activement à l’amélioration de l’organisation et du fonctionnement quotidien de l’atelier.   **Votre profil*** Vous êtes avant tout frigoriste de métier et justifiez d’une solide expérience technique. Vous disposez également de bonnes connaissances en mécanique automobile et/ou véhicules utilitaires.  * Vous maîtrisez le diagnostic de pannes et êtes à l’aise avec les environnements associant mécanique, froid, électricité et électronique.  *    + Vous disposez de bonnes connaissances informatiques et êtes à l’aise avec les outils de diagnostic, les logiciels de gestion d’atelier ainsi que les outils bureautiques nécessaires au suivi de l’activité.      + Autonome, méthodique et réactif(ve), vous savez organiser les priorités, anticiper les besoins et trouver des solutions face aux imprévus.      + Une première expérience dans la coordination d’une équipe ou l’organisation d’un atelier constitue un atout.      + Vous êtes titulaire d’un permis de conduire valable.        **Nous vous offrons :**    + Un environnement de travail convivial, dynamique et motivé      + Poste basé à Yverdon\-les\-Bains      + 5 semaines de congés      + Des prestations sociales attractives      + Entreprise certifiée Great Place to Work      + Une politique de formation continue innovante       Entrée en fonction : à convenir   **Candidatures acceptées uniquement via Jobup**    ![Fraikin Suisse SA]()*** ![Fraikin Suisse SA]()***jida5ef12bjm jit1147jm jiy26jm

title: Senior Non-Motor Pricing Actuary (m/f/d)
description: Shape sustainable pricing across Swiss Property, Household, Liability and SME insurance. You will combine actuarial modelling with underwriting insight and take end\-to\-end responsibility from exposure data and technical pricing to implementation and portfolio monitoring. Your work will help us make transparent, risk\-adequate decisions even where portfolios are heterogeneous and data are limited.Senior Non\-Motor Pricing Actuary (m/f/d)CELEBRATE SUCCESS, TOGETHER.Navigating real life together.**What to expect*** You develop, validate and enhance technical pricing models for selected Swiss Property, Household, Liability and SME portfolios.* You model frequency, attritional severity, large losses and inflation and apply exposure\-based methods that reflect sums insured, location, occupancy, business activity, limits and deductibles.* You combine statistical evidence with underwriting expertise when data are sparse or heterogeneous, while making assumptions and expert adjustments transparent and reviewable.* You translate analyses into practical tariff and underwriting measures, including minimum premiums, loadings, discounts, deductibles, limits and referral rules.* You take end\-to\-end responsibility from exposure\-data preparation and model documentation through implementation and testing. After launch, you measure realised impact against the approved business case, separating rate, exposure, risk\-mix, large\-loss, inflation and implementation effects.* You partner with Underwriting, Product Management, Claims, Reinsurance, Risk Management, Compliance, Data and IT and communicate uncertainty in a decision\-oriented way.* You improve reproducible pricing workflows and portfolio monitoring, responsibly apply AI\-assisted methods to data preparation, modelling, code review, testing and documentation, and support colleagues through technical review and mentoring.**The skills you'll bring*** You hold a degree in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, data science, economics or a comparable quantitative field.* You bring several years of hands\-on Non\-Life pricing experience in Property, Household, Liability, SME, Commercial or another relevant portfolio in Switzerland or a comparable European market.* You understand frequency\-severity and exposure modelling, credibility methods, large\-loss volatility and the challenges of incomplete or heterogeneous insurance data.* You have translated pricing analysis into tariff or underwriting decisions and have contributed to an implemented pricing tool, tariff or portfolio action.* You program confidently in at least one relevant analytical language, preferably Python, R or SAS. You actively explore approved AI\-assisted development tools, including coding copilots and agentic coding environments, and validate their outputs with professional judgement.* You have very good English and German skills. Willingness to build local expertise is expected.* An actuarial qualification or advanced progress toward SAV/SAA, DAV, IFoA, ACAS/FCAS or an equivalent credential, and experience with WTW Radar/Emblem, Akur8, Earnix, geospatial or external hazard data are advantages.**Your benefits**Your office? It's wherever you are! Depending on your workload, you can work up to 60% of your hours remotely – for more flexibility at work and at home.  Whether recreation, travel or training: with 6 weeks of annual leave, you've got plenty of time for you and your interests.  At our company, you're given lots of freedom to make decisions, think creatively and explore your own ideas: you shape your own career.  We support and challenge you – as shown by the wide range of internal training courses we offer to boost your future career.  It's not always easy to balance your job with your private life. That's why we offer the option of working part\-time.  Your health is very important to us. At our company, you can keep fit alongside your colleagues in a wide range of sports groups.**Your next step**Do you have any questions about an advertised job, your new team, Generali as an employer or our corporate culture? Francesca will be happy to help. We look forward to receiving your online application.Francesca  Recruiting \& Talent Acquisition Specialist**We, Generali**Generali is committed to equal opportunities. We welcome you regardless of age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, origin, ethnicity or religion.  Your salary in this position is aligned with your earned work experience, your responsibilities within the position and local industry standards.j4id10492262jm j4it1147jm j4iy26jm

description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Responsable Conformité (100%) --- Responsable Conformité (100%) ============================== L'Office cantonal des assurances sociales est une institution autonome de droit public et constitue un pôle de compétences dans les assurances sociales du 1er pilier. Il gère et coordonne quatre régimes d'assurance : assurance\\-vieillesse et survivants, assurance\\-invalidité, allocations familiales et allocations pour perte de gain. Pour relever les défis actuels, l'OCAS est à la recherche d'un\\-e \*\*Responsable conformité\*\* (100 %) Classe de fonction 23 Au sein du domaine des services partagés et rattaché\\-e au responsable adjoint du domaine, vous avez pour mission de construire et piloter le nouveau secteur conformité de l'OCAS. Vous donnez à l'institution une vue unique de sa maîtrise en matière de gestion des risques, de contrôle interne, de qualité, de sécurité de l'information et de protection des données. Pour ce faire, vous réunissez et développez les dispositifs existants que la loi impose aux organes d'exécution du 1er pilier. Dans un contexte réglementaire exigeant et en évolution, vous priorisez selon les risques que l'institution doit maîtriser. Dans une logique de deuxième ligne de maîtrise, vous élaborez et déployez progressivement le cadre méthodologique, accompagnez la mise en œuvre par les secteurs et les domaines, qui restent responsables de leurs risques, et contrôlez l'efficacité du dispositif. Vous rendez compte de l'état de maîtrise à la direction générale et à la commission risques du conseil d'administration. Vous conduisez une équipe de deux spécialistes en sécurité de l'information et en protection des données. Ce poste s'adresse à une personnalité fédératrice et résolue, dotée d'un bon esprit de synthèse, capable de faire appliquer des exigences de maîtrise sans se substituer aux métiers. \*\*Vos cadre de maîtrise \* Capacité à animer une équipe et un réseau transversal de répondants risques et contrôle interne \* Aptitude au reporting stratégique auprès des membres de la direction générale et du conseil d'administration \* Facilité d'adaptation, entregent et capacité à travailler avec des interlocuteurs internes et externes de tous niveaux \* Résistance aux tensions et caractère résolu
